corpus_hash_note: No corpus_hash is computed in S02 (the corpus carries zero event records). When events exist (S03/S04), corpus_hash is computed over the cycle-003 file set ONLY, by the same canonicalization the cycle-001 manifest used: sorted-key canonical JSON -> SHA-256 (the scripts/corona-backtest/replay/canonical-json.js + replay/hashes.js convention, referenced READ-ONLY; no edit to those files). CN-2 (binding): the cycle-003 corpus_hash is a DISTINCT value over a DISTINCT file set; it is NEVER substituted for, nor compared against, the frozen cycle-001 corpus_hash b1caef3f...11bb1 as if measuring the same corpus, and any future expanded-corpus baseline on it is a NEW regime, never an uplift delta vs Baseline A/B (HAZ-3 / CSG-2). || [S03 UPDATE 2026-05-31] entries[] now carries a per-file EOL-immune canonical-JSON SHA-256 (sha256OfCanonical = SHA-256 over replay/canonical-json.js RFC-8785-spirit canonicalization; stable across CRLF/LF). The FINAL top-level corpus_hash stays PENDING/null and is computed in S06 over the COMPLETE T1+T2+T4 tree via reporting/hash-utils.js computeCorpusHash (path-sorted; per file: relative-path + NUL + RAW FILE BYTES + NUL; SHA-256). NOTE (Windows/CRLF): computeCorpusHash hashes raw bytes, so S06 MUST run it over LF/committed-blob content (git autocrlf=true yields on-disk CRLF here); otherwise the hash drifts (cycle-001 b1caef3f is over LF content). Not computed in S03 because the corpus is incomplete (no T4).
